text: For all these things hath my hand made, and [so] all these things came to be, saith Jehovah: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and that trembleth at my word.

title: Isaiah 66:3
text: He that killeth an ox is as he that slayeth a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as he that breaketh a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, [as he that offereth] swine's blood; he that burneth frankincense, as he that blesseth an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations:

title: Isaiah 66:4
text: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delighted not.

title: Isaiah 66:5
text: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye that tremble at his word: Your brethren that hate you, that cast you out for my name's sake, have said, Let Jehovah be glorified, that we may see your joy; but it is they that shall be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 66:6
text: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Jehovah that rendereth recompense to his enemies.

title: Isaiah 66:7
text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man-child.

title: Isaiah 66:8
text: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? shall a nation be brought forth at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

title: Isaiah 66:9
text: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith Jehovah: shall I that cause to bring forth shut [the womb]? saith thy God.

title: Isaiah 66:10
text: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn over her;

title: Isaiah 66:11
text: that ye may suck and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

title: Isaiah 66:12
text: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream: and ye shall suck [thereof]; ye shall be borne upon the side, and shall be dandled upon the knees.

title: Isaiah 66:13
text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 66:14
text: And ye shall see [it], and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the tender grass: and the hand of Jehovah shall be known toward his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

title: Isaiah 66:15
text: For, behold, Jehovah will come with fire, and his chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

title: Isaiah 66:16
text: For by fire will Jehovah execute judgment, and by his sword, upon all flesh; and the slain of Jehovah shall be many.

title: Isaiah 66:17
text: They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves [to go] unto the gardens, behind one in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:18
text: For I [know] their works and their thoughts: [the time] cometh, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and shall see my glory.

title: Isaiah 66:19
text: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send such as escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

title: Isaiah 66:20
text: And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations for an oblation unto Jehovah, upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon dromedaries, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith Jehovah, as the children of Israel bring their oblation in a clean vessel into the house of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:21
text: And of them also will I take for priests [and] for Levites, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:22
text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith Jehovah, so shall your seed and your name remain.

title: Isaiah 66:23
text: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:24
text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the dead bodies of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

title: Jeremiah 1:1
text: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

title: Jeremiah 1:2
text: to whom the word of Jehovah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

title: Jeremiah 1:3
text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

title: Jeremiah 1:4
text: Now the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 1:5
text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee; I have appointed thee a prophet unto the nations.

title: Jeremiah 1:6
text: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, I know not how to speak; for I am a child.

title: Jeremiah 1:7
text: But Jehovah said unto me, Say not, I am a child; for to whomsoever I shall send thee thou shalt go, and whatsoever I shall command thee thou shalt speak.

title: Jeremiah 1:8
text: Be not afraid because of them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 1:9
text: Then Jehovah put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth:

title: Jeremiah 1:10
text: see, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.

title: Jeremiah 1:11
text: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond-tree.

title: Jeremiah 1:12
text: Then said Jehovah unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I watch over my word to perform it.

title: Jeremiah 1:13
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a boiling caldron; and the face thereof is from the north.

title: Jeremiah 1:14
text: Then Jehovah said unto me, Out of the north evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

title: Jeremiah 1:15
text: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith Jehovah; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 1:16
text: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

title: Jeremiah 1:17
text: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at them, lest I dismay thee before them.

title: Jeremiah 1:18
text: For, behold, I have made thee this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and brazen walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 1:19
text: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee, saith Jehovah, to deliver thee.

title: Jeremiah 2:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 2:2
text: Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, I remember for thee the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals; how thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

title: Jeremiah 2:3
text: Israel [was] holiness unto Jehovah, the first-fruits of his increase: all that devour him shall be held guilty; evil shall come upon them, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:4
text: Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

title: Jeremiah 2:5
text: thus saith Jehovah, What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

title: Jeremiah 2:6
text: Neither said they, Where is Jehovah that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that none passed through, and where no man dwelt?

title: Jeremiah 2:7
text: And I brought you into a plentiful land, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

title: Jeremiah 2:8
text: The priests said not, Where is Jehovah? and they that handle the law knew me not: the rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

title: Jeremiah 2:9
text: Wherefore I will yet contend with you, saith Jehovah, and with your children's children will I contend.

title: Jeremiah 2:10
text: For pass over to the isles of Kittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently; and see if there hath been such a thing.

title: Jeremiah 2:11
text: Hath a nation changed [its] gods, which yet are no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

title: Jeremiah 2:12
text: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:13
text: For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

title: Jeremiah 2:14
text: Is Israel a servant? is he a home-born [slave]? why is he become a prey?

title: Jeremiah 2:15
text: The young lions have roared upon him, and yelled; and they have made his land waste: his cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 2:16
text: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head.

title: Jeremiah 2:17
text: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, when he led thee by the way?

title: Jeremiah 2:18
text: And now what hast thou to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? or what hast thou to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

title: Jeremiah 2:19
text: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and a bitter, that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 2:20
text: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bonds; and thou saidst, I will not serve; for upon every high hill and under every green tree thou didst bow thyself, playing the harlot.

title: Jeremiah 2:21
text: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine unto me?

title: Jeremiah 2:22
text: For though thou wash thee with lye, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:23
text: How canst thou say, I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: [thou art] a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

title: Jeremiah 2:24
text: a wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind in her desire; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

title: Jeremiah 2:25
text: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, It is in vain; no, for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

title: Jeremiah 2:26
text: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;

title: Jeremiah 2:27
text: who say to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

title: Jeremiah 2:28
text: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

title: Jeremiah 2:29
text: Wherefore will ye contend with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:30
text: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

title: Jeremiah 2:31
text: O generation, see ye the word of Jehovah. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? or a land of thick darkness? wherefore say my people, We are broken loose; we will come no more unto thee?

title: Jeremiah 2:32
text: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

title: Jeremiah 2:33
text: How trimmest thou thy way to seek love! therefore even the wicked women hast thou taught thy ways.

title: Jeremiah 2:34
text: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the innocent poor: thou didst not find them breaking in; but it is because of all these things.

title: Jeremiah 2:35
text: Yet thou saidst, I am innocent; surely his anger is turned away from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

title: Jeremiah 2:36
text: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou shalt be ashamed of Egypt also, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

title: Jeremiah 2:37
text: From thence also shalt thou go forth, with thy hands upon thy head: for Jehovah hath rejected those in whom thou trustest, and thou shalt not prosper with them.

title: Jeremiah 3:1
text: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, will he return unto her again? will not that land be greatly polluted? But thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:2
text: Lift up thine eyes unto the bare heights, and see; where hast thou not been lain with? By the ways hast thou sat for them, as an Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

title: Jeremiah 3:3
text: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; yet thou hast a harlot's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

title: Jeremiah 3:4
text: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My Father, thou art the guide of my youth?

title: Jeremiah 3:5
text: Will he retain [his anger] for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and hast done evil things, and hast had thy way.

title: Jeremiah 3:6
text: Moreover Jehovah said unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

title: Jeremiah 3:7
text: And I said after she had done all these things, She will return unto me; but she returned not: and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

title: Jeremiah 3:8
text: And I saw, when, for this very cause that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorcement, yet treacherous Judah her sister feared not; but she also went and played the harlot.

title: Jeremiah 3:9
text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

title: Jeremiah 3:10
text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not returned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:11
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Backsliding Israel hath showed herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

title: Jeremiah 3:12
text: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith Jehovah; I will not look in anger upon you; for I am merciful, saith Jehovah, I will not keep [anger] for ever.

title: Jeremiah 3:13
text: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against Jehovah thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:14
text: Return, O backsliding children, saith Jehovah; for I am a husband unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

title: Jeremiah 3:15
text: and I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

title: Jeremiah 3:16
text: And it shall come to pass, when ye are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith Jehovah, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of Jehovah; neither shall it come to mind; neither shall they remember it; neither shall they miss it; neither shall it be made any more.

title: Jeremiah 3:17
text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Jehovah; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Jehovah, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

title: Jeremiah 3:18
text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance unto your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 3:19
text: But I said, How I will put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of the nations! and I said, Ye shall call me My Father, and shall not turn away from following me.

title: Jeremiah 3:20
text: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:21
text: A voice is heard upon the bare heights, the weeping [and] the supplications of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Jehovah their God.

title: Jeremiah 3:22
text: Return, ye backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we are come unto thee; for thou art Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 3:23
text: Truly in vain is [the help that is looked for] from the hills, the tumult on the mountains: truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 3:24
text: But the shameful thing hath devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

title: Jeremiah 3:25
text: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Jehovah our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day; and we have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 4:1
text: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith Jehovah, if thou wilt return unto me, and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight; then shalt thou not be removed;

title: Jeremiah 4:2
text: and thou shalt swear, As Jehovah liveth, in truth, in justice, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

title: Jeremiah 4:3
text: For thus saith Jehovah to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

title: Jeremiah 4:4
text: Circumcise yourselves to Jehovah, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

title: Jeremiah 4:5
text: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry aloud and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities.

title: Jeremiah 4:6
text: Set up a standard toward Zion: flee for safety, stay not; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 4:7
text: A lion is gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations; he is on his way, he is gone forth from his place, to make thy land desolate, that thy cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 4:8
text: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Jehovah is not turned back from us.

title: Jeremiah 4:9
text: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith Jehovah, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

title: Jeremiah 4:10
text: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the life.

title: Jeremiah 4:11
text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse;

title: Jeremiah 4:12
text: a full wind from these shall come for me: now will I also utter judgments against them.

title: Jeremiah 4:13
text: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots [shall be] as the whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are ruined.

title: Jeremiah 4:14
text: O Jerusalem, wash thy heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thine evil thoughts lodge within thee?

title: Jeremiah 4:15
text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth evil from the hills of Ephraim:

title: Jeremiah 4:16
text: make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, [that] watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 4:17
text: As keepers of a field are they against her round about, because she hath been rebellious against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 4:18
text: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reacheth unto thy heart.

title: Jeremiah 4:19
text: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart; my heart is disquieted in me; I cannot hold my peace; because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

title: Jeremiah 4:20
text: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is laid waste: suddenly are my tents destroyed, [and] my curtains in a moment.

title: Jeremiah 4:21
text: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

title: Jeremiah 4:22
text: For my people are foolish, they know me not; they are sottish children, and they have no understanding; they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

title: Jeremiah 4:23
text: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was waste and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

title: Jeremiah 4:24
text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved to and fro.

title: Jeremiah 4:25
text: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

title: Jeremiah 4:26
text: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Jehovah, [and] before his fierce anger.

title: Jeremiah 4:27
text: For thus saith Jehovah, The whole land shall be a desolation; yet will I not make a full end.

title: Jeremiah 4:28
text: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.

title: Jeremiah 4:29
text: Every city fleeth for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they go into the thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city is forsaken, and not a man dwelleth therein.

title: Jeremiah 4:30
text: And thou, when thou art made desolate, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with scarlet, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou enlargest thine eyes with paint, in vain dost thou make thyself fair; [thy] lovers despise thee, they seek thy life.

title: Jeremiah 4:31
text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that gaspeth for breath, that spreadeth her hands, [saying], Woe is me now! for my soul fainteth before the murderers.

title: Jeremiah 5:1
text: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that doeth justly, that seeketh truth; and I will pardon her.

title: Jeremiah 5:2
text: And though they say, As Jehovah liveth; surely they swear falsely.

title: Jeremiah 5:3
text: O Jehovah, do not thine eyes look upon truth? thou hast stricken them, but they were not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

title: Jeremiah 5:4
text: Then I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish; for they know not the way of Jehovah, nor the law of their God:

title: Jeremiah 5:5
text: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they know the way of Jehovah, and the law of their God. But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

title: Jeremiah 5:6
text: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall destroy them, a leopard shall watch against their cities; every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces; because their transgressions are many, [and] their backslidings are increased.

title: Jeremiah 5:7
text: How can I pardon thee? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the harlots' houses.

title: Jeremiah 5:8
text: They were as fed horses roaming at large; every one neighed after his neighbor's wife.

title: Jeremiah 5:9
text: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:10
text: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her branches; for they are not Jehovah's.

title: Jeremiah 5:11
text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 5:12
text: They have denied Jehovah, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

title: Jeremiah 5:13
text: and the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

title: Jeremiah 5:14
text: Wherefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

title: Jeremiah 5:15
text: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

title: Jeremiah 5:16
text: Their quiver is an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

title: Jeremiah 5:17
text: And they shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread, [which] thy sons and thy daughters should eat; they shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds; they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig-trees; they shall beat down thy fortified cities, wherein thou trustest, with the sword.

title: Jeremiah 5:18
text: But even in those days, saith Jehovah, I will not make a full end with you.

title: Jeremiah 5:19
text: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah our God done all these things unto us? then shalt thou say unto them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served foreign gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

title: Jeremiah 5:20
text: Declare ye this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 5:21
text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; that have eyes, and see not; that have ears, and hear not:

title: Jeremiah 5:22
text: Fear ye not me? saith Jehovah: will ye not tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it? and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it.

title: Jeremiah 5:23
text: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

title: Jeremiah 5:24
text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Jehovah our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in its season; that preserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

title: Jeremiah 5:25
text: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good from you.

title: Jeremiah 5:26
text: For among my people are found wicked men: they watch, as fowlers lie in wait; they set a trap, they catch men.

title: Jeremiah 5:27
text: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxed rich.

title: Jeremiah 5:28
text: They are waxed fat, they shine: yea, they overpass in deeds of wickedness; they plead not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

title: Jeremiah 5:29
text: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:30
text: A wonderful and horrible thing is come to pass in the land:

title: Jeremiah 5:31
text: the prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

title: Jeremiah 6:1
text: Flee for safety, ye children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth-haccherem; for evil looketh forth from the north, and a great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 6:2
text: The comely and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will I cut off.

title: Jeremiah 6:3
text: Shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

title: Jeremiah 6:4
text: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day declineth, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

title: Jeremiah 6:5
text: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

title: Jeremiah 6:6
text: For thus hath Jehovah of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

title: Jeremiah 6:7
text: As a well casteth forth its waters, so she casteth forth her wickedness: violence and destruction is heard in her; before me continually is sickness and wounds.

title: Jeremiah 6:8
text: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from thee; lest I make thee a desolation, a land not inhabited.

title: Jeremiah 6:9
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn again thy hand as a grape-gatherer into the baskets.

title: Jeremiah 6:10
text: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Jehovah is become unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

title: Jeremiah 6:11
text: Therefore I am full of the wrath of Jehovah; I am weary with holding in: pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

title: Jeremiah 6:12
text: And their houses shall be turned unto others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 6:13
text: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

title: Jeremiah 6:14
text: They have healed also the hurt of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

title: Jeremiah 6:15
text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall; at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 6:16
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Stand ye in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way; and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls: but they said, We will not walk [therein].

title: Jeremiah 6:17
text: And I set watchmen over you, [saying], Hearken to the sound of the trumpet; but they said, We will not hearken.

title: Jeremiah 6:18
text: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

title: Jeremiah 6:19
text: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

title: Jeremiah 6:20
text: To what purpose cometh there to me frankincense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt-offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices pleasing unto me.

title: Jeremiah 6:21
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people; and the fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 6:22
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, a people cometh from the north country; and a great nation shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 6:23
text: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea, and they ride upon horses, every one set in array, as a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Zion.

title: Jeremiah 6:24
text: We have heard the report thereof; our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, [and] pangs as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 6:25
text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy, [and] terror, are on every side.

title: Jeremiah 6:26
text: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation; for the destroyer shall suddenly come upon us.

title: Jeremiah 6:27
text: I have made thee a trier [and] a fortress among my people; that thou mayest know and try their way.

title: Jeremiah 6:28
text: They are all grievous revolters, going about with slanders; they are brass and iron: they all of them deal corruptly.

title: Jeremiah 6:29
text: The bellows blow fiercely; the lead is consumed of the fire: in vain do they go on refining; for the wicked are not plucked away.

title: Jeremiah 6:30
text: Refuse silver shall men them, because Jehovah hath rejected them.

title: Jeremiah 7:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 7:2
text: Stand in the gate of Jehovah's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Jehovah, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 7:3
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

title: Jeremiah 7:4
text: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, are these.

title: Jeremiah 7:5
text: For if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

title: Jeremiah 7:6
text: if ye oppress not the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your own hurt:

title: Jeremiah 7:7
text: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even for evermore.

title: Jeremiah 7:8
text: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

title: Jeremiah 7:9
text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods that ye have not known,

title: Jeremiah 7:10
text: and come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered; that ye may do all these abominations?

title: Jeremiah 7:11
text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 7:12
text: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

title: Jeremiah 7:13
text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith Jehovah, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not:

title: Jeremiah 7:14
text: therefore will I do unto the house which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

title: Jeremiah 7:15
text: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

title: Jeremiah 7:16
text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me; for I will not hear thee.

title: Jeremiah 7:17
text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

title: Jeremiah 7:18
text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink-offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

title: Jeremiah 7:19
text: Do they provoke me to anger? saith Jehovah; [do they] not [provoke] themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?

title: Jeremiah 7:20
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, mine anger and my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

title: Jeremiah 7:21
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ye flesh.

title: Jeremiah 7:22
text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt-offerings or sacrifices:

title: Jeremiah 7:23
text: but this thing I commanded them, saying, Hearken unto my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people; and walk ye in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.

title: Jeremiah 7:24
text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in [their own] counsels [and] in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

title: Jeremiah 7:25
text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day, I have sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

title: Jeremiah 7:26
text: yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff: they did worse than their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 7:27
text: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

title: Jeremiah 7:28
text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the nation that hath not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah their God, nor received instruction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

title: Jeremiah 7:29
text: Cut off thy hair, [O Jerusalem], and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Jehovah hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

title: Jeremiah 7:30
text: For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight, saith Jehovah: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

title: Jeremiah 7:31
text: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither came it into my mind.

title: Jeremiah 7:32
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter: for they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place [to bury].

title: Jeremiah 7:33
text: And the dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.

title: Jeremiah 7:34
text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall become a waste.

title: Jeremiah 8:1
text: At that time, saith Jehovah, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;

title: Jeremiah 8:2
text: and they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and which they have sought, and which they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried, they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 8:3
text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 8:4
text: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah: Shall men fall, and not rise up again? Shall one turn away, and not return?

title: Jeremiah 8:5
text: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

title: Jeremiah 8:6
text: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repenteth him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turneth to his course, as a horse that rusheth headlong in the battle.

title: Jeremiah 8:7
text: Yea, the stork in the heavens knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle-dove and the swallow and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the law of Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:8
text: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of Jehovah is with us? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes hath wrought falsely.

title: Jeremiah 8:9
text: The wise men are put to shame, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of Jehovah; and what manner of wisdom is in them?

title: Jeremiah 8:10
text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall possess them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

title: Jeremiah 8:11
text: And they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

title: Jeremiah 8:12
text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall; in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:13
text: I will utterly consume them, saith Jehovah: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig-tree, and the leaf shall fade; and [the things that] I have given them shall pass away from them.

title: Jeremiah 8:14
text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there; for Jehovah our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:15
text: We looked for peace, but no good came; [and] for a time of healing, and, behold, dismay!

title: Jeremiah 8:16
text: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan: at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones the whole land trembleth; for they are come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it; the city and those that dwell therein.

title: Jeremiah 8:17
text: For, behold, I will send serpents, adders, among you, which will not be charmed; and they shall bite you, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:18
text: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! my heart is faint within me.

title: Jeremiah 8:19
text: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: is not Jehovah in Zion? is not her King in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with foreign vanities?

title: Jeremiah 8:20
text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

title: Jeremiah 8:21
text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt: I mourn; dismay hath taken hold on me.

title: Jeremiah 8:22
text: Is there no balm in Gilead? is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

title: Jeremiah 9:1
text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

title: Jeremiah 9:2
text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging-place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

title: Jeremiah 9:3
text: And they bend their tongue, [as it were] their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 9:4
text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbor, and trust ye not in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.

title: Jeremiah 9:5
text: And they will deceive every one his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies; they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

title: Jeremiah 9:6
text: Thy habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 9:7
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how [else] should I do, because of the daughter of my people?

title: Jeremiah 9:8
text: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he layeth wait for him.

title: Jeremiah 9:9
text: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 9:10
text: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none passeth through; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the birds of the heavens and the beasts are fled, they are gone.

title: Jeremiah 9:11
text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling-place of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 9:12
text: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and [who is] he to whom the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken, that he may declare it? wherefore is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passeth through?

title: Jeremiah 9:13
text: And Jehovah saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein,

title: Jeremiah 9:14
text: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baalim, which their fathers taught them;

title: Jeremiah 9:15
text: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

title: Jeremiah 9:16
text: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them.

title: Jeremiah 9:17
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for the skilful women, that they may come:

title: Jeremiah 9:18
text: and let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

title: Jeremiah 9:19
text: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we ruined! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.

title: Jeremiah 9:20
text: Yet hear the word of Jehovah, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbor lamentation.

title: Jeremiah 9:21
text: For death is come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to cut off the children from without, [and] the young men from the streets.

title: Jeremiah 9:22
text: Speak, Thus saith Jehovah, The dead bodies of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman; and none shall gather [them].

title: Jeremiah 9:23
text: Thus saith Jehovah, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches;

title: Jeremiah 9:24
text: but let him that glorieth glory in this, that he hath understanding, and knoweth me, that I am Jehovah who exerciseth lovingkindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 9:25
text: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will punish all them that are circumcised in [their] uncircumcision:

title: Jeremiah 9:26
text: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that have the corners [of their hair] cut off, that dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.

title: Jeremiah 10:1
text: Hear ye the word which Jehovah speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

title: Jeremiah 10:2
text: thus saith Jehovah, Learn not the way of the nations, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the nations are dismayed at them.

title: Jeremiah 10:3
text: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

title: Jeremiah 10:4
text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

title: Jeremiah 10:5
text: They are like a palm-tree, of turned work, and speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither is it in them to do good.

title: Jeremiah 10:6
text: There is none like unto thee, O Jehovah; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

title: Jeremiah 10:7
text: Who should not fear thee, O King of the nations? for to thee doth it appertain; forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like unto thee.

title: Jeremiah 10:8
text: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

title: Jeremiah 10:9
text: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skilful men.

title: Jeremiah 10:10
text: But Jehovah is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembleth, and the nations are not able to abide his indignation.

title: Jeremiah 10:11
text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

title: Jeremiah 10:12
text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding hath he stretched out the heavens:

title: Jeremiah 10:13
text: when he uttereth his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries.

title: Jeremiah 10:14
text: Every man is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his graven image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

title: Jeremiah 10:15
text: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 10:16
text: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

title: Jeremiah 10:17
text: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O thou that abidest in the siege.

title: Jeremiah 10:18
text: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel [it].

title: Jeremiah 10:19
text: Woe is me because of my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is [my] grief, and I must bear it.

title: Jeremiah 10:20
text: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are not: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

title: Jeremiah 10:21
text: For the shepherds are become brutish, and have not inquired of Jehovah: therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks are scattered.

title: Jeremiah 10:22
text: The voice of tidings, behold, it cometh, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling-place of jackals.

title: Jeremiah 10:23
text: O Jehovah, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

title: Jeremiah 10:24
text: O Jehovah, correct me, but in measure: not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

title: Jeremiah 10:25
text: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have devoured Jacob, yea, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

title: Jeremiah 11:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 11:2
text: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

title: Jeremiah 11:3
text: and say thou unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Cursed be the man that heareth not the words of this covenant,

title: Jeremiah 11:4
text: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God;

title: Jeremiah 11:5
text: that I may establish the oath which I sware unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day. Then answered I, and said, Amen, O Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 11:6
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

title: Jeremiah 11:7
text: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

title: Jeremiah 11:8
text: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the stubbornness of their evil heart: therefore I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they did them not.

title: Jeremiah 11:9
text: And Jehovah said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 11:10
text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words; and they are gone after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 11:11
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and they shall cry unto me, but I will not hearken unto them.

title: Jeremiah 11:12
text: Then shall the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem go and cry unto the gods unto which they offer incense: but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

title: Jeremiah 11:13
text: For according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

title: Jeremiah 11:14
text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me because of their trouble.

title: Jeremiah 11:15
text: What hath my beloved to do in my house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness [with] many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

title: Jeremiah 11:16
text: Jehovah called thy name, A green olive-tree, fair with goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

title: Jeremiah 11:17
text: For Jehovah of hosts, who planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have wrought for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense unto Baal.

title: Jeremiah 11:18
text: And Jehovah gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it: then thou showedst me their doings.

title: Jeremiah 11:19
text: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, [saying], Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

title: Jeremiah 11:20
text: But, O Jehovah of hosts, who judgest righteously, who triest the heart and the mind, I shall see thy vengeance on them; for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

title: Jeremiah 11:21
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Thou shalt not prophesy in the name of Jehovah, that thou die not by our hand;

title: Jeremiah 11:22
text: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

title: Jeremiah 11:23
text: and there shall be no remnant unto them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

title: Jeremiah 12:1
text: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, when I contend with thee; yet would I reason the cause with thee: wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they at ease that deal very treacherously?

title: Jeremiah 12:2
text: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root; they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

title: Jeremiah 12:3
text: But thou, O Jehovah, knowest me; thou seest me, and triest my heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

title: Jeremiah 12:4
text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? for the wickedness of them that dwell therein, the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our latter end.

title: Jeremiah 12:5
text: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and though in a land of peace thou art secure, yet how wilt thou do in the pride of the Jordan?

title: Jeremiah 12:6
text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; even they have cried aloud after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

title: Jeremiah 12:7
text: I have forsaken my house, I have cast off my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

title: Jeremiah 12:8
text: My heritage is become unto me as a lion in the forest: she hath uttered her voice against me; therefore I have hated her.

title: Jeremiah 12:9
text: Is my heritage unto me as a speckled bird of prey? are the birds of prey against her round about? go ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, bring them to devour.

title: Jeremiah 12:10
text: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 12:11
text: They have made it a desolation; it mourneth unto me, being desolate; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.

title: Jeremiah 12:12
text: Destroyers are come upon all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Jehovah devoureth from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh hath peace.

title: Jeremiah 12:13
text: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns; they have put themselves to pain, and profit nothing: and ye shall be ashamed of your fruits, because of the fierce anger of Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 12:14
text: Thus saith Jehovah against all mine evil neighbors, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

title: Jeremiah 12:15
text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them; and I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

title: Jeremiah 12:16
text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, As Jehovah liveth; even as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built up in the midst of my people.

title: Jeremiah 12:17
text: But if they will not hear, then will I pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 13:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah unto me, Go, and buy thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

title: Jeremiah 13:2
text: So I bought a girdle according to the word of Jehovah, and put it upon my loins.

title: Jeremiah 13:3
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto me the second time, saying,

title: Jeremiah 13:4
text: Take the girdle that thou hast bought, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.

title: Jeremiah 13:5
text: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Jehovah commanded me.

title: Jeremiah 13:6
text: And it came to pass after many days, that Jehovah said unto me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

title: Jeremiah 13:7
text: Then I went to the Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it; and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

title: Jeremiah 13:8
text: Then the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 13:9
text: Thus saith Jehovah, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 13:10
text: This evil people, that refuse to hear my words, that walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is profitable for nothing.

title: Jeremiah 13:11
text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith Jehovah; that they may be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

title: Jeremiah 13:12
text: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

title: Jeremiah 13:13
text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

title: Jeremiah 13:14
text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith Jehovah: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have compassion, that I should not destroy them.

title: Jeremiah 13:15
text: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud; for Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Jeremiah 13:16
text: Give glory to Jehovah your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

title: Jeremiah 13:17
text: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret for [your] pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because Jehovah's flock is taken captive.

title: Jeremiah 13:18
text: Say thou unto the king and to the queen-mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headtires are come down, even the crown of your glory.

title: Jeremiah 13:19
text: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is none to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.

title: Jeremiah 13:20
text: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

title: Jeremiah 13:21
text: What wilt thou say, when he shall set over thee as head those whom thou hast thyself taught to be friends to thee? shall not sorrows take hold of thee, as of a woman in travail?

title: Jeremiah 13:22
text: And if thou say in thy heart, Wherefore are these things come upon me? for the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts uncovered, and thy heels suffer violence.

title: Jeremiah 13:23
text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

title: Jeremiah 13:24
text: Therefore will I scatter them, as the stubble that passeth away, by the wind of the wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 13:25
text: This is thy lot, the portion measured unto thee from me, saith Jehovah; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

title: Jeremiah 13:26
text: Therefore will I also uncover thy skirts upon thy face, and thy shame shall appear.

title: Jeremiah 13:27
text: I have seen thine abominations, even thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, on the hills in the field. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! thou wilt not be made clean; how long shall it yet be?

title: Jeremiah 14:1
text: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.

title: Jeremiah 14:2
text: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish, they sit in black upon the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

title: Jeremiah 14:3
text: And their nobles send their little ones to the waters: they come to the cisterns, and find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are put to shame and confounded, and cover their heads.

title: Jeremiah 14:4
text: Because of the ground which is cracked, for that no rain hath been in the land, the plowmen are put to shame, they cover their heads.

title: Jeremiah 14:5
text: Yea, the hind also in the field calveth, and forsaketh [her young], because there is no grass.

title: Jeremiah 14:6
text: And the wild asses stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.

title: Jeremiah 14:7
text: Though our iniquities testify against us, work thou for thy name's sake, O Jehovah; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

title: Jeremiah 14:8
text: O thou hope of Israel, the Saviour thereof in the time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a sojourner in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

title: Jeremiah 14:9
text: Why shouldest thou be as a man affrighted, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O Jehovah, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

title: Jeremiah 14:10
text: Thus saith Jehovah unto this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore Jehovah doth not accept them; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

title: Jeremiah 14:11
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Pray not for this people for [their] good.

title: Jeremiah 14:12
text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt-offering and meal-offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

title: Jeremiah 14:13
text: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

title: Jeremiah 14:14
text: Then Jehovah said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name; I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake I unto them: they prophesy unto you a lying vision, and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their own heart.

title: Jeremiah 14:15
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

title: Jeremiah 14:16
text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them-them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

title: Jeremiah 14:17
text: And thou shalt say this word unto them, Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

title: Jeremiah 14:18
text: If I go forth into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then, behold, they that are sick with famine! for both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.

title: Jeremiah 14:19
text: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul loathed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and, behold, dismay!

title: Jeremiah 14:20
text: We acknowledge, O Jehovah, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against thee.

title: Jeremiah 14:21
text: Do not abhor [us], for thy name's sake; do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

title: Jeremiah 14:22
text: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O Jehovah our God? therefore we will wait for thee; for thou hast made all these things.

title: Jeremiah 15:1
text: Then said Jehovah unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

title: Jeremiah 15:2
text: And it shall come to pass, when they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith Jehovah: Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.

title: Jeremiah 15:3
text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith Jehovah: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

title: Jeremiah 15:4
text: And I will cause them to be tossed to and fro among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 15:5
text: For who will have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who will bemoan thee? or who will turn aside to ask of thy welfare?

title: Jeremiah 15:6
text: Thou hast rejected me, saith Jehovah, thou art gone backward: therefore have I stretched out my hand against thee, and destroyed thee; I am weary with repenting.

title: Jeremiah 15:7
text: And I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land; I have bereaved [them] of children, I have destroyed my people; they returned not from their ways.

title: Jeremiah 15:8
text: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas; I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday: I have caused anguish and terrors to fall upon her suddenly.

title: Jeremiah 15:9
text: She that hath borne seven languisheth; she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day; she hath been put to shame and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 15:10
text: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; [yet] every one of them doth curse me.

title: Jeremiah 15:11
text: Jehovah said, Verily I will strengthen thee for good; verily I will cause the enemy to make supplication unto thee in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

title: Jeremiah 15:12
text: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and brass?

title: Jeremiah 15:13
text: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

title: Jeremiah 15:14
text: And I will make [them] to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not; for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.

title: Jeremiah 15:15
text: O Jehovah, thou knowest; remember me, and visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered reproach.

title: Jeremiah 15:16
text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy words were unto me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by thy name, O Jehovah, God of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 15:17
text: I sat not in the assembly of them that make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand; for thou hast filled me with indignation.

title: Jeremiah 15:18
text: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou indeed be unto me as a deceitful [brook], as waters that fail?

title: Jeremiah 15:19
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, that thou mayest stand before me; and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: they shall return unto thee, but thou shalt not return unto them.

title: Jeremiah 15:20
text: And I will make thee unto this people a fortified brazen wall; and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 15:21
text: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

title: Jeremiah 16:1
text: The word of Jehovah came also unto me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 16:2
text: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters, in this place.

title: Jeremiah 16:3
text: For thus saith Jehovah concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land:

title: Jeremiah 16:4
text: They shall die grievous deaths: they shall not be lamented, neither shall they be buried; they shall be as dung upon the face of the ground; and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 16:5
text: For thus saith Jehovah, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament, neither bemoan them; for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith Jehovah, even lovingkindness and tender mercies.

title: Jeremiah 16:6
text: Both great and small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;

title: Jeremiah 16:7
text: neither shall men break [bread] for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

title: Jeremiah 16:8
text: And thou shalt not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.

title: Jeremiah 16:9
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

title: Jeremiah 16:10
text: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt show this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath Jehovah pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Jehovah our God?

title: Jeremiah 16:11
text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith Jehovah, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

title: Jeremiah 16:12
text: and ye have done evil more than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that ye hearken not unto me:

title: Jeremiah 16:13
text: therefore will I cast you forth out of this land into the land that ye have not known, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; for I will show you no favor.

title: Jeremiah 16:14
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be said, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

title: Jeremiah 16:15
text: but, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries whither he had driven them. And I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 16:16
text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith Jehovah, and they shall fish them up; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

title: Jeremiah 16:17
text: For mine eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from mine eyes.
